label: Semifreddo
note: Italian, "half-cold"; earliest mention Antonio Nebbia, Il cuoco maceratese, 1779, semifreddo fior di latte of milk, sugar and cream

about.text: An Italian frozen dessert of whipped cream, egg whites and sugar, frozen in a mould for a light, mousse-like texture.
